title: Oven Roasted Korean Tofu Fried Chicken
description: A tangy, flaky plant‑based dish that mimics Korean fried chicken using roasted tofu, bird's‑eye chilies, and a coconut‑cream glaze.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: pressed and cut into 2 cm cubes

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk coconut cream, gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, agave syrup, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and sesame oil until smooth.
Gently fold tofu cubes into the sauce, ensuring each piece is well coated.
Sprinkle chopped bird's eye chilies over the tofu.
Arrange tofu on the prepared sheet in a single layer, leaving space between cubes.
Roast for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until edges are golden and slightly crisp.
Remove from oven and let rest 5 minutes.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the tofu and drizzle with a light drizzle of soy sauce if desired.
Serve hot with a side of steamed rice or lettuce wraps.
Enjoy your plant‑based Korean fried chicken experience.
